body:
Bring the Cursor hook surface to parity with the Claude Code plugin's six hook modes (rails, buildgate, preflight, flail, manifest, review), within what Cursor's hook events support.

=== PINNED CURSOR HOOK FACTS (ADR-0006) ===
Events pinned against docs: preToolUse (blockable, JSON stdin/stdout, permission allow|deny|ask), afterFileEdit (observational, cannot block), beforeShellExecution, beforeReadFile. NOT yet pinned: `stop` and `beforeSubmitPrompt`. VERIFY-FIRST DISCIPLINE: before wiring stop/beforeSubmitPrompt, verify against current Cursor hooks documentation that the event exists and pin its payload shape in ADR-0006 (same defensive-extraction approach the preToolUse adapter uses). If an event cannot be verified, ship that mode DISABLED-by-default with a documented enable flag and a pinning TODO — do not wire an invented event name as if real.

=== MODES TO ADD (all advisory except buildgate, which mirrors rails' best-effort deny) ===
1. buildgate (preToolUse, second entry): port the fitness-to-build gate (issue #48; reference implementation plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook.mjs buildgate mode). Deny a structured edit when the active ticket is high-risk AND the session context-fitness signal is degraded, unless ADLC_BUILD_GATE_BYPASS=1 with an audited gate-manifest record. Risk-tier/decide logic MUST be imported from @adlc/build-gate (packages/build-gate — it already exists as the reusable Path-A toolkit package; do NOT hand-copy the KEEP-IN-SYNC port the CC hook uses — Cursor hooks already resolve workspace deps, same as @adlc/core in rails-checker.mjs). Context-fitness input: Cursor hooks do not receive a transcript_path; derive depth from a session tool-call counter persisted under .adlc/ by the hook itself (document the proxy's weakness honestly) or accept ADLC_BUILD_GATE_DEPTH env input.
2. flail (afterFileEdit, piggyback in adlc-audit.mjs): after the rail audit, run the flail heuristics (packages/flail-detector primitives) over the hook's own persisted recent-edits window; advisory stderr notice only.
3. stop-audit (stop event, IF pinnable): run `adlc gate-manifest verify --json` + the risk-gated adversarial-review check (packages/core/lib/risk-tier.mjs decideAdversarialReviewNotice — same logic as issue #59's CC/OpenCode triggers); advisory notice only.
4. preflight (beforeSubmitPrompt, IF pinnable): once per session (persist a marker under .adlc/), run `adlc preflight --json`; advisory. Include the ADLC precedence assertion when .adlc/ exists ("route work through the ADLC gates; other process skills plug into phases").
5. shell advisory (beforeShellExecution): NEVER deny. Pattern-match the command string for obvious writes to the active ticket's rail paths or trust roots (.adlc/tickets.json, .adlc/current-ticket.json) — e.g. redirection/sed -i/rm/mv/cp targets — and emit an advisory agent_message reminding that CI catches rail edits regardless of how they are made. Document plainly this is trivially bypassable and exists only to keep an honest agent honest (ADR-0006 threat model: shell is Turing-complete, the CI gate is the control).

=== WIRING ===
Extend plugins/adlc-cursor/hooks.json + lib/scaffold.mjs mergeHooks() for the new entries (all failClosed:false; buildgate matcher '.*' like rails). mergeHooks must remain idempotent and non-clobbering for user hooks; isAdlcHook() must recognize the new script names.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: buildgate denies a high-risk-ticket edit past the depth threshold and allows otherwise; unaudited bypass refused. VERIFY: new plugins/adlc-cursor/test/build-gate.test.mjs invoking the real hook entry with fixture payloads (offline, temp dirs), covering deny/allow/bypass-audited/bypass-unaudited.
- AC2: buildgate imports @adlc/build-gate (no inlined risk/decide copy). VERIFY: test asserts the import; grep confirms no local deriveRiskSignals/isDegraded implementation.
- AC3: flail advisory fires on a synthetic churn window, silent otherwise. VERIFY: unit test on the audit hook with fixture window.
- AC4: each of stop-audit/preflight is either (a) wired against a verified-and-ADR-pinned event, or (b) shipped disabled with the pinning TODO recorded in ADR-0006 — no invented events. VERIFY: ADR-0006 diff pins the verified facts; hooks.json only references verified events; test asserts disabled modes are absent from hooks.json.
- AC5: shell advisory emits on a fixture command targeting a rail and stays silent on a benign command; never denies. VERIFY: unit test with both fixtures asserting permission is always allow/absent.
- AC6: existing rails-guard behavior unchanged: frozen plugins/adlc-cursor/test/rails-guard.test.mjs passes with zero diff. VERIFY: node --test + git diff --stat.
- AC7: scaffold merge idempotent with the new entries; user hooks preserved. VERIFY: extended scaffold test.
- AC8: full `npm test` + both sibling smoke scripts exit 0.

=== P1 DESIGN-REVIEW AMENDMENTS (binding — override any conflicting text above) ===
1. SINGLE preToolUse DISPATCHER, not a second entry. Cursor's multi-entry-per-event ordering and permission-combination semantics are UNPINNED; a second entry could mask a rails deny. Ship ONE new hook script plugins/adlc-cursor/hooks/adlc-pretool.mjs that: (a) runs the rails decision FIRST by importing the frozen guard's existing exports (adlc-rails-guard.mjs is a RAIL — import, never modify); (b) only if rails allows, consults buildgate; (c) returns a rails deny unchanged. mergeHooks() rewires preToolUse to the dispatcher (hooks.json is scaffold-managed, not frozen) and must migrate/replace a pre-existing direct adlc-rails-guard.mjs entry (isAdlcHook already matches it). NEW test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/pretool-dispatch.test.mjs asserts: a rails deny survives a buildgate allow; buildgate is only consulted on rails-allow; dispatcher output shape matches the pinned preToolUse contract.
2. IMPORT FORM (pinned): @adlc/build-gate has no main/exports — a bare import throws ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Sanctioned form is ANY lib/*.mjs deep subpath of either package — e.g. '@adlc/build-gate/lib/risk.mjs', 'lib/decide.mjs', 'lib/active-ticket.mjs', and NOTE ALSO 'lib/depth-signal.mjs' (isDegraded — required by AC2's no-local-copy grep) and 'lib/override.mjs' (recordOverride, for the audited-bypass path); same for @adlc/flail-detector's lib subpaths. The list is illustrative, not exhaustive: import whatever lib module is needed rather than hand-copying it. packages/build-gate/** stays frozen (no exports-map edit). Declare BOTH packages as dependencies in plugins/adlc-cursor/package.json; cursor-install-smoke must assert the declarations exist (workspace-root resolution masks a missing declaration in in-repo tests).
3. BUILDGATE DEFAULT-OFF + SESSION-SCOPED DEPTH. buildgate is advisory with NO unbypassable backstop (the CI gate protects rails, not fitness-to-build; the depth signal is an agent-writable .adlc/ file — never claim otherwise in any doc). It ships DISABLED by default behind ADLC_BUILD_GATE_ENFORCEMENT=1. The depth counter must be session-scoped: verify whether Cursor hook payloads carry a conversation/session id and pin the fact in ADR-0006; if unpinnable, scope by TTL/mtime staleness with an explicit documented window. AC (new): a fresh session starts un-degraded — test proves the counter resets/expires and a new session is not denied by stale depth.
4. Scope is the explicit file list above — hooks/** was too broad (it contained the frozen rail adlc-rails-guard.mjs by glob; the rail stays frozen and out of scope).

=== P1 ROUND-2 AMENDMENTS (binding) ===
1. DISPATCHER DELEGATION PINNED: adlc-pretool.mjs obtains the rails verdict by calling the frozen guard's exported decide() with the UNMODIFIED parsed payload and returns any deny VERBATIM. It must NOT re-assemble extraction from lower-level exports (checkRail/extractFilePaths) — that would silently lose the hardened extraction paths (MultiEdit edits[], apply_patch envelope headers, no-path opaque-mutator fail-closed, multi-root ownership) while all existing tests stay green. pretool-dispatch.test.mjs must additionally drive the DISPATCHER entrypoint with the guard suite's adversarial payload shapes (batch edits[] array, apply_patch '*** Update File:' string, pathless structured mutator under enforcement, corrupt tickets.json) and assert the dispatcher's verdict is identical to calling decide() directly on the same payload.
2. LAZY BUILDGATE IMPORT: the @adlc/build-gate deep-subpath imports happen via dynamic import() ONLY after (a) the rails decision returned allow AND (b) ADLC_BUILD_GATE_ENFORCEMENT=1 — a buildgate module-load failure must never take down the rails path. pretool-dispatch.test.mjs simulates a buildgate import failure (e.g. broken specifier via test seam) and asserts a rails deny still emits for a rail-targeting payload.
3. packages/flail-detector/** is a rail (consumed via lib subpaths, never modified — same doctrine as build-gate).

=== P5 HOLLOW-TEST AMENDMENT (binding) ===
Scope gains plugins/adlc-cursor/test/stop-preflight.test.mjs: the disabled-by-default stop/preflight hooks are opt-in wireable enforcement-adjacent code and hollow-test proved their behavior (skip-when-uninitialized, TTL once-per-session marker, runner status mapping) had zero coverage. Dedicated tests required.
title: Cursor hook parity: buildgate, flail, stop-audit, preflight, shell advisory
